home.welcome.heading: Welcome to Tradepass
home.welcome.body: Answer one question and we'll set up your application form and suggest tier names that fit your business. You can change everything later.
home.welcome.question: Who do you sell wholesale to?
home.checklist.heading: Setup guide
home.checklist.tier.title: Create your first tier
home.checklist.tier.body: A tier is a wholesale price level, for example 20% off retail. Approved buyers are added to a tier.
home.checklist.form.title: Review your application form
home.checklist.form.body: Check the questions businesses answer when they apply, then save the form.
home.checklist.embed.title: Turn on Tradepass in your theme
home.checklist.embed.body: Switch on the Tradepass app embed in your theme editor and save. Tradepass never changes your theme files.
home.checklist.block.title: Add the application form to a page
home.checklist.block.body: Create a page such as "Wholesale", then add the "Wholesale application form" block to it in the theme editor.
home.checklist.storefront.title: Choose what non-wholesale visitors see
home.checklist.storefront.body: Decide whether retail visitors see prices, see a sign-in message, or can't shop at all.
home.checklist.test.title: Send a test application
home.checklist.test.body: Fill in the form on your store once. This step turns green when the application arrives.

home.alert.embed_off.body: Wholesale prices, messages and the application form won't show until you turn the app embed back on.
